glosses: to stretch over, to put on something held by elasticity

examples.translation: Put the fitted sheet onto the mattress.
examples.english: Put the fitted sheet onto the mattress.

examples.translation: The laborers tensioned the ropes of the circus tent.
examples.english: The laborers tensioned the ropes of the circus tent.

glosses: to pull, to injure a muscle or tendon by stretching it too far

examples.text: Wczoraj naciągnąłem mięsień na siłowni, nadal boli.
examples.translation: Yesterday I pulled a muscle at the gym, it still hurts.
examples.english: Yesterday I pulled a muscle at the gym, it still hurts.

examples.text: Dzieci znowu naciągnęły mnie na McDonalda.
